parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

*   **0**: custom
*   **1**: system

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-aegis-container-plugin-rule --lang zh --criteria name_:_name_,_value_:_test-1818 --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --rule-type 0 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
